subject: a 17th-century Mexican Hieronymite nun in her thirties with a calm, intelligent oval face and dark eyes, wearing a white habit with a long black veil, a large round oval badge (escudo de monja) painted with a religious scene pinned at the throat, and a rosary

panels.01-reading: a tiny girl of about three in a simple colonial dress sitting on a bench at the back of a small village schoolroom in New Spain in 1651, staring at a hornbook with fierce concentration while older girls recite, a surprised woman teacher looking at her, volcanoes visible through the window
panels.02-library: a girl of about seven in a colonial dress sitting on the floor of a hacienda library in 1655, surrounded by open leather-bound books taken from tall shelves, reading by afternoon light, a grandfather's desk and quill nearby, mountains outside, New Spain
panels.03-scholars: a young woman of seventeen in an elegant 17th-century Spanish court dress standing calmly in a viceregal palace hall in Mexico City in 1665, answering questions from a semicircle of robed theologians, lawyers and poets, the viceroy and vicereine watching from chairs, candlelight, admiration
panels.04-convent: {S}, about twenty, entering the cloister of the convent of San Jerónimo in Mexico City in 1669, arched stone walkway around a garden with a fountain, other nuns welcoming her, quiet and peaceful morning light
panels.05-spinningtop: {S} kneeling in a convent courtyard watching two young girls spin a wooden top on a floor dusted with sifted flour, leaning close to study the spiral path it leaves, a small sieve in her hand, curious smile, New Spain, 17th century
panels.06-stage: {S} in a convent locutory window watching actors in Spanish Golden Age costume rehearse a comedy in 1683, holding a handwritten script, candles and a small stage set with painted doors, lively and joyful
panels.07-respuesta: {S} writing late at night at a desk in her convent cell in 1691, quill in hand, a long letter before her, surrounded by tall shelves of books, a globe, an astrolabe and musical instruments, a single candle, determined expression, no readable text
panels.08-nursing: {S} in 1695 kneeling beside a simple bed in a convent infirmary, gently giving water to a sick older nun, other nuns helping with basins and blankets, soft window light, compassionate and quiet, no graphic illness shown
